observations: body L2, L4: the 2 and the 1 of «٢١١» (L2) and of «٢١» (L4) touch (4.3 points together), close to the width of a 3 (4.6-4.8 points on this page); the 1 has its own stem.
body L4: two small points (0.7 and 1.1 points) are printed after «cfr.» and after «I,»; not transcribed.
body L12, L13: the sukūn of «رَأْس» at the end of L12 touches its hamza (one piece, 3.5 by 5.6 points); in «رَأْس» of L13 it keeps its hole.
body L13: the second t of «al-Battānī» is printed without its crossbar, so that the name resembles «al-Batlānī».

body L14, L15, L26: the 2 and the 9 of «٢٩» (L14, L15) touch (5.6 and 5.8 points), as in «١٢٩» on p. 330; the last digit of «٥٢» (L26) is 3.0 points wide, that of «٥٣» 4.7; a 3 measures 4.6-4.8 points on this page.
body L16: a point (1.6 by 1.9 points) is printed after the line number 10 of «١٩٥», where the other references of the line are separated by commas (1.7 by 3.4 points); transcribed as printed.
body L19: the teeth of the s of the last «راس» are printed filled, so that the word resembles «رامى».
body L20: a dot is printed below the end of «راس»; not transcribed.
body L24, L32, L36: «مَرْئِيّ» (L24), «الرُّبْع» (L32) and «تَرْبِيعٌ» (L36) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L32: a thin horizontal stroke (3.2 by 1.1 points) is printed above the ‘ayn of «الرُّبْع»; not transcribed.
notes_left L2: «p» is printed without a point; «والاربع» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed.
notes_right L1: a short stroke is printed below the r of «quadrati» and a point below its t; not transcribed. The hyphen of «in-» is printed as a short point (1.8 points).
